description: Returns what this site has queued, posted or failed to post to its social channels, newest first. `status` is one of queued / sent / failed / cancelled. A FAILED row carries `error` saying what the network answered — that sentence is the whole point of this tool, because it is the only place the reason survives. `retry-announcement` can re-queue a failed row; nothing here can write a new announcement. ⛔ This lists what was SCHEDULED, not what a network shows now: a post deleted at the network still reads "sent" here, because this is the site’s own record of what it sent.

page.description: Which page of the ledger (1-based, 20 a page).

name: agentimus-read-announcements

canRetry.description: TRUE only on a failed row — retry-announcement refuses anything else.

error.description: Why it failed, in the network’s own words. Empty unless status is "failed".

network.description: Where it goes: x, linkedin, telegram, …

postId.description: The post being announced — 0 if the row has none.

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601, UTC. When it goes out, or went.

failed.description: Rows worth telling the owner about — each carries its reason.

sentWeek.description: Sent in the last 7 days. NOT an all-time count.

title: Read the announcement ledger
